concept: One engraved brass nameplate for a made-up company on an oxblood front door, shot three ways. Along the door, the name running towards us until Ltd is the biggest thing in the picture. Then right up against those three letters, cut into the metal, with the plate's end and its two screws. Then square on, with a second plate screwed on beneath it carrying the rest of what gov.uk says a limited company's website has to show. Oxblood gloss paint, polished brass, black enamel and cream.
